hook: Why Wanting Too Hard Pushes It Away

voices.name: l00
voices.text: Ever notice that the more desperately you want something, <#0.2#> the further it goes?
voices.caption: Ever notice that the more desperately you want something, the further it goes?

voices.name: l01
voices.text: The more you wait, the less they call. <#0.2#> The more you cling, the faster it slips away.
voices.caption: The more you wait, the less they call. The more you cling, the faster it slips away.

voices.name: l02
voices.text: Wanting that comes from fear quietly says: <#0.3#> I'm not enough as I am.
voices.caption: Wanting that comes from fear quietly says: I'm not enough as I am.

voices.name: l03
voices.text: Squeeze a handful of sand, <#0.2#> and it slips right through your fingers.
voices.caption: Squeeze a handful of sand, and it slips right through your fingers.

voices.name: l04
voices.text: Open your hand, <#0.2#> and the sand stays.
voices.caption: Open your hand, and the sand stays.

voices.name: l05
voices.text: Dream vividly. Take action. <#0.3#> And then, gently, let go.
voices.caption: Dream vividly. Take action. And then, gently, let go.
